name: 🎁[Gifting + 3 Chars] DragonBall: Ultimate Clash 2
desc: (If you don't know how to play click the options button in the menu!) Ahh..."DragonBall: Ultimate Clash 2" a sequel to the game "Dragonball: Ultimate Clash". Many upgrades from the first game but you should see for yourself. Anyways, this is a game where you choose your favorite characters and fight friends and enemies alike! Don't hold back! And always have fun! Characters owned by Toei Animation and FUNimation, please support them! Also if you like the game join our group Defunction Studios to support us! :) [If you haven't played Rage Rebirth 2 yet, here give it a try it's what helped bring this game to life! https://www.roblox.com/games/575451053/13-1-5-Rage-Rebirth-2] https://www.roblox.com/games/3624837313/Infinite-Fighters [Another classic that inspired this one! https://www.roblox.com/games/33409138/DragonBall-Sparking-Meteor, https://www.roblox.com/games/30187442/Dragon-ball-Sparking-Met ...
